verses.en: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor se compadecerá de Jacó, e ainda escolherá a Israel e os porá na sua própria terra; e ajuntar-se-ão com eles os estrangeiros, e se apegarão à casa de Jacó.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will again make Israel his special people, and will put them in their land; and the man from a strange country will take his place among them and be joined to the family of Jacob.

verses.en: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.pt: E os povos os receberão, e os levarão aos seus lugares; e a casa de Israel os possuirá por servos e por servas, na terra do Senhor e cativarão aqueles que os cativaram, e dominarão os seus opressores.
verses.en_web: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.en_bbe: And the people will take them with them to their place: and the children of Israel will give them a heritage in the Lord's land as men-servants and women-servants, making them prisoners whose prisoners they were; and they will be rulers over their masters.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.pt: No dia em que Deus vier a dar-te descanso do teu trabalho, e do teu tremor, e da dura servidão com que te fizeram servir,
verses.en_web: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
verses.en_bbe: And it will be, in the day when the Lord gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your trouble, and from the hard yoke which they had put on you,

verses.en: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.pt: proferirás esta parábola contra o rei de Babilônia, e dirás: Como cessou o opressor! como cessou a tirania!
verses.en_web: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
verses.en_bbe: That you will take up this bitter song against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the cruel overseer come to an end! He who was lifted up in pride is cut off;

verses.en: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.pt: Já quebrantou o Senhor o bastão dos ímpios e o cetro dos dominadores;
verses.en_web: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
verses.en_bbe: The stick of the evil-doers, the rod of the rulers, is broken by the Lord;

verses.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.pt: cetro que feria os povos com furor, com açoites incessantes, e que em ira dominava as nações com uma perseguição irresistível.
verses.en_web: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
verses.en_bbe: He whose rod was on the peoples with an unending wrath, ruling the nations in passion, with an uncontrolled rule.

verses.en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.pt: Toda a terra descansa, e está sossegada! Rompem em brados de júbilo.
verses.en_web: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
verses.en_bbe: All the earth is at rest and is quiet: they are bursting into song.

verses.en: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.pt: Até as faias se alegram sobre ti, e os cedros do Líbano, dizendo: Desde que tu caiste ninguém sobe contra nós para nos cortar.
verses.en_web: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
verses.en_bbe: Even the trees of the wood are glad over you, the trees of Lebanon, saying, From the time of your fall no wood-cutter has come up against us with an axe.

verses.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.pt: O Seol desde o profundo se turbou por ti, para sair ao teu encontro na tua vinda; ele despertou por ti os mortos, todos os que eram príncipes da terra, e fez levantar dos seus tronos todos os que eram reis das nações.
verses.en_web: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: The underworld is moved at your coming: the shades of the dead are awake before you, even the strong ones of the earth; all the kings of the world have got up from their seats.

verses.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.pt: Estes todos responderão, e te dirão: Tu também estás fraco como nós, e te tornaste semelhante a nós.
verses.en_web: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
verses.en_bbe: They all make answer and say to you, Have you become feeble like us? have you been made even as we are?

verses.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.pt: Está derrubada até o Seol a tua pompa, o som dos teus alaúdes; os bichinhos debaixo de ti se estendem e os bichos te cobrem.
verses.en_web: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
verses.en_bbe: Your pride has gone down into the underworld, and the noise of your instruments of music; the worms are under you, and your body is covered with them.

verses.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.pt: Como caíste do céu, ó estrela da manhã, filha da alva! como foste lançado por terra tu que prostravas as nações!
verses.en_web: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
verses.en_bbe: How great is your fall from heaven, O shining one, son of the morning! How are you cut down to the earth, low among the dead bodies!

verses.en: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.pt: E tu dizias no teu coração: Eu subirei ao céu; acima das estrelas de Deus exaltarei o meu trono; e no monte da congregação me assentarei, nas extremidades do norte;
verses.en_web: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
verses.en_bbe: For you said in your heart, I will go up to heaven, I will make my seat higher than the stars of God; I will take my place on the mountain of the meeting-place of the gods, in the inmost parts of the north.

verses.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.pt: subirei acima das alturas das nuvens, e serei semelhante ao Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
verses.en_bbe: I will go higher than the clouds; I will be like the Most High.

verses.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.pt: Contudo levado serás ao Seol, ao mais profundo do abismo.
verses.en_web: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
verses.en_bbe: But you will come down to the underworld, even to its inmost parts.

verses.en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.pt: Os que te virem te contemplarão, considerar-te-ão, e dirão: É este o varão que fazia estremecer a terra, e que fazia tremer os reinos?
verses.en_web: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms;
verses.en_bbe: Those who see you will be looking on you with care, they will be in deep thought, saying, Is this the troubler of the earth, the shaker of kingdoms?

verses.en: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.pt: Que punha o mundo como um deserto, e assolava as suas cidades? que a seus cativos não deixava ir soltos para suas casas?
verses.en_web: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities; who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
verses.en_bbe: Who made the world a waste, overturning its towns; who did not let his prisoners loose from the prison-house.

verses.en: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.pt: Todos os reis das nações, todos eles, dormem com glória, cada um no seu túmulo.
verses.en_web: All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
verses.en_bbe: All the kings of the earth are at rest in glory, every man in his house,

verses.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.pt: Mas tu és lançado da tua sepultura, como um renovo abominável, coberto de mortos atravessados a espada, como os que descem às pedras da cova, como cadáver pisado aos pés.
verses.en_web: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
verses.en_bbe: But you, like a birth before its time, are stretched out with no resting-place in the earth; clothed with the bodies of the dead who have been put to the sword, who go down to the lowest parts of the underworld; a dead body, crushed under foot.

verses.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.pt: Com eles não te reunirás na sepultura; porque destruíste a tua terra e mataste o teu povo. Que a descendência dos malignos não seja nomeada para sempre!
verses.en_web: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
verses.en_bbe: As for your fathers, you will not be united with them in their resting-place, because you have been the cause of destruction to your land, and of death to your people; the seed of the evil-doer will have no place in the memory of man.

verses.en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.pt: Preparai a matança para os filhos por causa da maldade de seus pais, para que não se levantem, e possuam a terra, e encham o mundo de cidades.
verses.en_web: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
verses.en_bbe: Make ready a place of death for his children, because of the evil-doing of their father; so that they may not come up and take the earth for their heritage, covering the face of the world with waste places.

verses.en: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Levantar-me-ei contra eles, diz o Senhor dos exércitos, e exterminarei de Babilônia o nome, e os sobreviventes, o filho, e o neto, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For I will come up against them, says the Lord of armies, cutting off from Babylon name and offspring, son and son's son, says the Lord.

verses.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: E reduzi-la-ei a uma possessão do ouriço, e a lagoas de águas; e varrê-la-ei com a vassoura da destruição, diz o Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make you a heritage for the hedgehog, and pools of water: and I will go through it with the brush of destruction, says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.pt: O Senhor dos exércitos jurou, dizendo: Como pensei, assim sucederá, e como determinei, assim se efetuará.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has taken an oath, saying, My design will certainly come about, and my purpose will be effected:

verses.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.pt: Quebrantarei o assírio na minha terra e nas minhas montanhas o pisarei; então o seu jugo se apartará deles e a sua carga se desviará dos seus ombros.
verses.en_web: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
verses.en_bbe: To let the Assyrian be broken in my land, and crushed under foot on my mountains: there will his yoke be taken away from them, and his rule over them come to an end.

verses.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.pt: Este é o conselho que foi determinado sobre toda a terra; e esta é a mão que está estendida sobre todas as nações.
verses.en_web: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
verses.en_bbe: This is the purpose for all the earth: and this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

verses.en: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.pt: Pois o Senhor dos exércitos o determinou, e quem o invalidará? A sua mão estendida está, e quem a fará voltar atrás?
verses.en_web: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
verses.en_bbe: For it is the purpose of the Lord of armies, and who will make it of no effect? when his hand is stretched out, by whom may it be turned back?

verses.en: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.pt: No ano em que morreu o rei Acaz, veio este oráculo.
verses.en_web: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.
verses.en_bbe: In the year of the death of King Ahaz this word came to the prophet:

verses.en: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.pt: Não te alegres, ó Filístia toda, por ser quebrada a vara que te feria; porque da raiz da cobra sairá um basilisco, e o seu fruto será uma serpente voadora.
verses.en_web: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.en_bbe: Be not glad, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod which was on you is broken: for out of the snake's root will come a poison-snake, and its fruit will be a winged poison-snake.

verses.en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.pt: E os primogênitos dos pobres serão apascentados, e os necessitados se deitarão seguros; mas farei morrer de fome a tua raiz, e será destruído o teu restante.
verses.en_web: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
verses.en_bbe: And the poorest of the land will have food, and those in need will be given a safe resting-place: but your seed will come to an end for need of food, and the rest of you will be put to the sword.

verses.en: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.pt: Uiva, ó porta; grita, ó cidade; tu, ó Filístia, estás toda derretida; porque do norte vem fumaça; e não há vacilante nas suas fileiras.
verses.en_web: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.en_bbe: Send out a cry, O door! Make sounds of sorrow, O town! All your land has come to nothing, O Philistia; for there comes a smoke out of the north, and everyone keeps his place in the line.

verses.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.pt: Que se responderá pois aos mensageiros do povo? Que o Senhor fundou a Sião, e que nela acharão refúgio os aflitos do seu povo.
verses.en_web: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
verses.en_bbe: What answer, then, will my people give to the representatives of the nation? That the Lord is the builder of Zion, and she will be a safe place for the poor of his people.
